_meta.title: Qwen3.5-9B encoder (~9 GB) - type MUST be moss_image
FLUX.2 VAE (also encodes the reference sheet)
4-STEP SPEED LoRA - REQUIRED at steps:4. The old revision dropped this in favour of the edit LoRA, which is why 4-step output looked underbaked. Chain them: 1 -> 4 -> 21.

EDIT LoRA - required for the reference to bind at all. A/B THIS FIRST if quality regresses vs the no-ref workflow: drop strength to 0.5, or delete this node and reconnect 4 -> 11 to see the base quality with no reference.

REF 1 - built-in. ST substitutes "%char_avatar%" with bare base64. PERCENT SIGNS MANDATORY and it must be the whole value. NB: in GROUP chats ST picks the last speaker else a RANDOM member - drive slots 2-4 from custom placeholders for deterministic casting.

REF 2 - custom placeholder {find:'ref2'}. Leave unset for a solo scene: the sheet node DROPS it, so no blank conditioning. Set replace to '%user_avatar%' to use your persona, or '{{getvar::name_b64}}'.
REF 3 - custom placeholder {find:'ref3'}. Dropped automatically when unset.
REF 4 - custom placeholder {find:'ref4'}. Dropped automatically when unset.

Drops blank/unset slots and tiles the rest into ONE 1024^2 sheet: 1 ref -> full frame (identical to a dedicated single-ref graph), 2 -> side by side, 3-4 -> 2x2. THIS is what lets one workflow serve solo and group scenes. target_size MUST equal node 10's latent size. Replaces the old per-slot ImageScale nodes.

inputs.string_a: Keep the character in the reference image exactly as shown: same face, hair colour and style, eye colour, skin tone and build. Reference panels read left-to-right then top-to-bottom; ignore any blank panel. Scene:

_meta.title: Edit instruction + scene. KEEP string_a SHORT - MOSS edit wants a concise instruction, not a paragraph. string_b must stay exactly "%prompt%" (ST only substitutes a standalone quoted value). LoRA trigger tokens go at the START of string_a.

Reference-conditioned positive. `images` is a v3 Autogrow input (min 1 / max 10) - in API format each slot is a FLAT DOTTED KEY images.image_N. Only image_0 is used here because node 40 already collapsed the references into one sheet. If identity fidelity is too weak for multi-character scenes, switch to one full-res slot per reference (see README 'Native Autogrow alternative'). edit_format is a GUESS - try 'ai-toolkit' if transfer is weak.
Negative. Live at cfg 3 (inert only at cfg 1.0).
Latent 1024x1024 (MOSS-Image trained square). MUST match node 40's target_size. The old revision used 512 here, halving detail.

steps 4 / cfg 3.0 / euler / sgm_uniform - matches the LIVE settings that produced the good no-ref images (read back out of ComfyUI /history). The repo previously said cfg 1.0 + simple, which had drifted from what was actually deployed. Only valid because node 4 supplies the speed LoRA.
